newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate drop on late paper glut.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate drop on late paper glut.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 280 basis points at 15.70 percent on Monday.
Analysts said rates fell due to a heavy amount of liquidity chasing relatively scarce paper.
"It was the limit. A big player who had been withholding a heavy paper position took advantage of demand to sell it at lower rates," a fixed-income analyst said.
Overnight rates on bank paper closed down 150 basis points at 18.50 percent. Banco de Mexico injected 261 million pesos of liquidity by auctioning a single secondary market credit.
